title: Creeper Babies
description: Adds tiny baby creepers with TNT breeding, Golden Dandelion friendship, leads, and gunpowder luring.
body:
# Creeper Babies

Creeper Babies is a Fabric mod that adds tiny baby creepers to Minecraft. It is inspired by the fun idea of smaller baby mobs while giving creepers their own special breeding, friendship, and pet-like behavior.

Baby creepers do not spawn naturally. To get one, feed TNT to two normal creepers. The creepers will show heart particles, walk toward each other, and create a baby creeper. Baby creepers stay small forever and do not grow into adult creepers.

Baby creepers are still creepers, but their explosion is much smaller than a normal creeper explosion. Their blast is designed to be a tiny one-block-style explosion instead of a full creeper crater.

You can use a Golden Dandelion on a baby creeper to make it friendly. Friendly baby creepers change texture, stop exploding, and can be lured with gunpowder. Baby creepers can also be attached to leads, making them easier to move around your world.

## Features

* Adds tiny baby creepers
* Adds a Baby Creeper Spawn Egg
* Breed creepers by feeding TNT to two normal creepers
* No breeding cooldown
* Creepers show heart particles and walk together before breeding
* Baby creepers stay small forever
* Baby creepers have smaller hitboxes
* Baby creepers have smaller explosions
* Use a Golden Dandelion to make a baby creeper friendly
* Friendly baby creepers do not explode
* Friendly baby creepers have a different texture
* Lure friendly baby creepers with gunpowder
* Use leads on baby creepers

## How to get a baby creeper

1. Find or spawn two normal creepers.
2. Right-click each creeper with TNT.
3. Wait for them to walk toward each other.
4. A baby creeper will appear.

## How to make a baby creeper friendly

Right-click a baby creeper with a Golden Dandelion. Once friendly, it will change texture and stop exploding.

## Important installation info

This mod must be installed on both the client and the server. It adds a custom entity, item, textures, and gameplay behavior, so it is not server-side only.

## Compatibility

* Minecraft: 26.2
* Mod loader: Fabric
* Requires Fabric API
